title: Ship v10.0 External Runtime Productization Decision
goal: Decide whether AOF external runtime should advance as a product-grade capability surface or remain research-grade, using v9.x readiness evidence, explicit not-proven boundaries, and Council-governed go/defer criteria without authorizing live provider execution.
not_proven: TASK-120 does not prove third-party adoption, product-market fit, live provider execution safety, billing safety, credential readiness, irreversible operation safety, or production authorization.
